messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. This is a fun creative coding task. Let me think about how to construct this.

A pelican has: large body, distinctive long beak with a pouch, small head, webbed feet, wings. A bicycle has: two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals, seat.

Let me design a scene. I'll use a viewBox like 0 0 400 300. Let me lay out the bicycle: two wheels at y ~220, centers at x ~120 and x ~280, radius ~40. Frame connecting them, handlebars at right (front wheel) and seat at left-ish top. Pelican sits on the seat, body above the frame, head/beak extending forward (to the right) over the handlebars. Feet on pedals.

Let me keep it stylized but recognizable. White pelican body with orange beak.

I'll write coordinates carefully.

Wheels: circle cx=110 cy=230 r=45; circle cx=290 cy=230 r=45. Spokes as lines. Frame: from seat area (~170,150) down to crank (~200,230), handlebars (~290,185). Let's make a triangle-ish frame.

Crank at center (200,230). Pedals offset. Pelican feet on pedals.

Body: ellipse centered ~ (170,140) rx=55 ry=45 white. Neck/head going up-right to head at (~230,95) r=22. Beak long pointing right: from (245,100) to tip (330,110), with pouch curve below. Eye dot. Wing on body. Legs from body bottom (~150,175) down to pedal at (~185,215) and (~215,245).

Let me just produce a clean SVG with reasonable shapes. I'll add small details: handlebar, seat, wheel spokes, ground line.

Let me write it out. I'll be generous with comments for readability.

Final answer: the SVG code block plus brief note. Keep it self-contained.
answer:
Here's a stylized pelican cycling away to the right:

```svg
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="300">
  <!-- ground -->
  <line x1="20" y1="278" x2="380" y2="278" stroke="#888" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- bicycle wheels -->
  <g stroke="#222" stroke-width="4" fill="none">
    <circle cx="110" cy="230" r="45"/>
    <circle cx="290" cy="230" r="45"/>
    <!-- spokes -->
    <g stroke-width="1.5">
      <line x1="110" y1="185" x2="110" y2="275"/><line x1="65" y1="230" x2="155" y2="230"/>
      <line x1="78" y1="198" x2="142" y2="262"/><line x1="142" y1="198" x2="78" y2="262"/>
      <line x1="290" y1="185" x2="290" y2="275"/><line x1="245" y1="230" x2="335" y2="230"/>
      <line x1="258" y1="198" x2="322" y2="262"/><line x1="322" y1="198" x2="258" y2="262"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- frame -->
  <g stroke="#b31217" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="110" y1="230" x2="200" y2="230"/>  <!-- rear hub to crank -->
    <line x1="200" y1="230" x2="165" y2="150"/>  <!-- crank to seat -->
    <line x1="165" y1="150" x2="110" y2="230"/>  <!-- seat to rear hub -->
    <line x1="200" y1="230" x2="285" y2="185"/>  <!-- crank to handlebar -->
    <line x1="165" y1="150" x2="285" y2="185"/>  <!-- seat to handlebar -->
    <line x1="290" y1="230" x2="285" y2="185"/>  <!-- front hub to handlebar -->
  </g>

  <!-- seat & handlebar -->
  <path d="M150 150 q15 -10 30 0 q-15 8 -30 0 z" fill="#333"/>
  <line x1="270" y1="178" x2="300" y2="172" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- crank + pedals -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="230" r="6" fill="#222"/>
  <line x1="200" y1="230" x2="175" y2="205" stroke="#222" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="165" y1="205" x2="185" y2="205" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="200" y1="230" x2="222" y2="248" stroke="#222" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="212" y1="248" x2="232" y2="248" stroke="#222" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- pelican legs -->
  <g stroke="#e08a1e" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M150 170 L160 195 L175 205"/>
    <path d="M175 175 L195 220 L222 248"/>
  </g>

  <!-- pelican body -->
  <ellipse cx="170" cy="140" rx="58" ry="46" fill="#f7f7f7" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <path d="M135 125 Q175 110 205 140 Q170 165 135 150 Z" fill="#e6e6e6" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- neck + head -->
  <path d="M205 130 Q225 110 230 95" stroke="#f7f7f7" stroke-width="16" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="232" cy="92" r="22" fill="#f7f7f7" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="240" cy="86" r="3" fill="#222"/>

  <!-- beak + pouch -->
  <path d="M248 92 L335 104 Q300 112 258 104 Z" fill="#f0a020" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M258 104 Q285 122 318 108" fill="none" stroke="#c8770e" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M112 135 L88 128 L110 150 Z" fill="#e6e6e6" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2"/>
</svg>
```

You can paste this into any `.svg` file or an HTML page. Want it bigger, animated (wheels spinning), or in a flatter cartoon style? Just say the word.
